name: CIVNFT
fix_description: Function 0x7ca06d68 accepts a user-supplied contract address (arg0) and calls its functions (0xd0c93a7c, 0x3850c7bd) trusting the return values. Attacker deploys a fake contract that returns manipulated values to bypass validation logic. Fix: whitelist allowed contract addresses or validate the address against a registry.
difficulty_reasoning: This is essentially a missing access control / trust-of-callback exploit: the attacker passes a fake Uniswap V3 pool and triggers the vulnerable contract to pull tokens from the victim via a forged mint callback. The PoC is short, has only a couple of key calls, and requires minimal protocol-specific reasoning beyond basic callback spoofing.
